name: Palette customization generates OKLCH color ramps and extracts palettes from canvas
description: Verify drawing a solid colored ball with multiple contrasting colors, generating perceptually uniform OKLCH color ramps, and extracting a custom palette by scanning canvas pixels.

planSteps.description: Select the Ellipse tool (press O), ensure shape mode in context bar is 'Shape: Filled Solid', press down on canvas, drag diagonally for at least 150 pixels, and release to draw a prominent circle
Select the Flood Fill tool (press G), choose a vibrant color swatch, and click inside the circle to solidly color it
Select the Pen tool (press B) and paint several colorful marks across the ball using 2 different palette colors
Click the 'Palette' tab button in the right inspector panel
Verify the palette preset selector is visible with color swatches
Click the '+ OKLCH Ramp' button in the palette panel
Verify 5 new harmonious color swatches are appended to the active palette
Click the 'Scan Canvas' button in the palette panel
Verify a new palette preset named 'Extracted' is generated containing the unique colors found on the drawn ball
